items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Terminology 42:1
items.html: At the completion of the forty days, 37 sparks of the filling of SAG entered the fetus, which are the phase of Bina, who is the mother that forms the fetus. (Item 21).
